title: Not three tools. One process.
returns_desc: Quantifies the real outcome after broker costs. Output: net capital, cumulative cost drag, broker comparison.
exposure_desc: Aligns the instrument to its effective risk. Output: equivalent exposure across ETF, CFD, Futures, Options and Turbo/KO on the same underlying.
flow_desc: Identifies anomalous activity and relevant signals before entry. Output: conviction score, noise filter.
